div.div:
LEGEND & LAYERS
• Black solid (2.5 px): primary compass/passage movement (double arrowhead = two-way)
• Blue solid (2.8 px): vertical UPWAR / DOWN shaft (distinct from compass N/S)
• Purple dashed: magic word / special transition · Local markers: yellow = cross-page · orange = transient · red = death
• Optional layer [Parser Aliases / Fast Travel] (hidden by default): non-adjacent keyword shortcuts

text.tspan: • Black solid (2.5 px): primary compass/passage movement (double arrowhead = two-way)

• Optional layer [Parser Aliases / Fast Travel] (hidden by default): non-adjacent keyword shortcuts

div.div:
LOC_LONGEAST — at east end of long hallYou are at the east end of a very long hall apparently without side
chambers. To the east a low wide crawl slants up. To the north a
round two foot hole slants down.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. EAST, UPWAR, CRAWL → LOC_MISTWEST
2. WEST → LOC_LONGWEST
3. NORTH, DOWN, HOLE → LOC_CROSSOVER [Ch 03]

div.div:
LOC_MISTWEST — at west end of Hall of MistsYou are at the west end of the Hall of Mists. A low wide crawl
continues west and another goes north. To the south is a little
passage 6 feet off the floor.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. SOUTH, UPWAR, PASSA, CLIMB → LOC_ALIKE1
2. EAST → LOC_WESTBANK [Ch 02]
3. NORTH → LOC_PARALLEL2
4. WEST, CRAWL → LOC_LONGEAST

LOC_PITBRINK — at brink of pitYou are on the brink of a thirty foot pit with a massive orange column
down one wall. You could climb down here but you could not get back
up. The maze continues at this level.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. DOWN, CLIMB → LOC_BIRDCHAMBER [Ch 02]
2. WEST → LOC_ALIKE10
3. SOUTH → LOC_MAZEEND6
4. NORTH → LOC_ALIKE12
5. EAST → LOC_ALIKE13

LOC_TOPSTALACTITE — at top of stalactiteA large stalactite extends from the roof and almost reaches the floor
below. You could climb down it, and jump from it to the floor, but
having done so you would be unable to reach it to climb back up.

1. NORTH → LOC_SECRET2 [Ch 05]
2. DOWN, JUMP, CLIMB → LOC_ALIKE6 [40%]
3. DOWN → LOC_ALIKE9 [50%]
4. DOWN → LOC_ALIKE4
